Rights and credit basis: a pre-credit partial rights deduction lowers the credited amount to the deducted effective commission (no credit at the undeducted settle amount); R10 closes WAIT_COMMISSION; order.clawed_back carries the new payload; migration 0109 adds order_rights.answered_at (nullable, no default, no backfill, column UPDATE grant to couli_app only) set in the same transaction when the union answer absorbs a deduction, so only unanswered deductions count before credit (S0 fix, D10-483). Generated db/schema.sql / db.gen.ts re-snapshotted on the test machine without drift.
